Shine in the dark
Introducing Murano® Dark Armor, a bold statement in design.
Conquer the city and beyond with a style that’s equally striking
and understated, featuring gloss black bumper accents and side
moldings, a gloss black rear diffuser, 21" gloss black aluminum-
alloy wheels with gloss black aero covers, and distinct Dark Armor
badges. Murano Dark Armor screams confidence and still brings a
sleekness that somehow never goes unnoticed.
Nissan Murano® Dark Armor shown in Boulder Gray Pearl / Super Black Two-tone.4
